mapper.select: SELECT pay29_other_setup_id AS id, pay29_start_date AS start_date FROM (SELECT * , ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY pay29_start_date) AS rn FROM pay29_other_setup) t WHERE rn = 1 ORDER BY pay29_start_date DESC
SELECT FROM pay29_other_setup WHERE pay29_start_date = #{startDate} ORDER BY pay29_hi_max_div

mapper.insert: INSERT INTO pay29_other_setup ( pay29_other_setup_id, pay29_start_date, pay29_hi_max_div, pay29_ei_max_div , pay29_hi_min_amt, pay29_hi_max_amt, pay29_np_min_amt, pay29_np_max_amt , pay29_std_tax_deduct, pay29_note) VALUES ( #{id}, #{row.startDate}, #{row.hiMaxDiv}, #{row.eiMaxDiv} , #{row.hiMinAmt}, #{row.hiMaxAmt}, #{row.npMinAmt}, #{row.npMaxAmt} , #{row.stdTaxDeduct}, #{row.note})
